Frontend PaymentSection verified on mobile viewport (390x844) after email/password login (bstest@jobby.app / test1234): after confirming a Pulizie richiesta the 3 buttons render (pay-card / pay-paypal / pay-wallet); tapping pay-wallet transitions to 'Pagamento in garanzia' with the release-payment button visible; tapping release-payment transitions to the released state ('Compenso accreditato'). critical_code_review_comments: payments_split._amounts uses r.prezzo_finale as charge, but the wizard/richieste engine stores prezzo_finale = prop.price (which equals breakdown.total_client = work + fee_client for impresa binario). Debit == 41.92, provider_net == 36.07, jobby_fee == 11.70 → JOBBY keeps 41.92 - 36.07 = 5.85 which equals fee_provider (half of jobby_fee), NOT the full jobby_fee. The other half (fee_client 5.85) is already collected via pagamento_fee.stato=charged at confirm time. So the requirement 'JOBBY keeps its full service fee' is satisfied only when the pagamento_fee half is also counted. Not a bug — just note that the split-payment endpoint only holds/releases the provider-side half; the client-side fee half is charged upstream at confirm.

payments_split.start_checkout does not verify r.stato ∈ {confermata,in_corso,completata}; it only checks provider_scelto is set. This could allow paying on a request that was later cancelled — consider stato guard.
release_simulated allows either client OR provider to release. Typically only the client should release (or auto-release on completion). Consider restricting to cliente_id (or trigger via /complete).
